story: An operator receives an actionable failure for invalid or conflicting concurrency testing input.
acceptance: Missing fields, stale revision and unsupported configuration return explicit failure without partial success, invented evidence or silently skipped checks.

story: A security reviewer can verify access boundaries for concurrency testing.
acceptance: Cross-tenant, unapproved, revoked and insufficient-authority requests are denied before protected reads or writes, including direct API and replay paths.

story: An auditor can reconstruct the concurrency testing outcome.
acceptance: Record actor, tenant, version, correlation and actual result; exercise retry/restart behavior without duplicate side effects. Read-only and simulation actions never create operational approval/evidence results.
